topic: Reviewing analytics data and feature implementation
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on reviewing analytics data, specifically concerning discrepancies in location reporting (e.g., Brazil). Concerns were raised about whether sensor and virtual location data were activated simultaneously or if other factors influenced the reported metrics.

Later, a discussion occurred regarding moving partial data to production. It was confirmed that existing reports for specific cities (like those managed by DataCorp) would continue to function using the live production data without requiring separate activation steps.
decisions: Partial data set will be moved to production environment.
Existing city reports (DataCorp related) can utilize the new production data without additional setup.
action_items: Review and analyze analytics discrepancies for the period November 23 - April 24, considering non-simultaneous activation of sensors/virtual locations.
